content.text:
I've submitted **index 15** (Sb 0.654 / Zn 0.346) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, but all three values are very low (under 0.01%), and with only three points I can't be sure it's the best in the library.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.22 | 0.00069 |
| **15** | **0.654** | **0.00638** |
| 19 | 0.753 | 0.00500 |

- **What guided the picks:** index 15 sits almost exactly at the composition of ZnSb2O6. The bandgap model (MEGNet) predicts that phase at 1.97 eV, just under the 2.1 eV light, so it should absorb. Index 0 matches Zn7Sb2O12, which the stability model (MACE) puts on the stability limit, but its EQE was about ten times lower. The Gaussian-process (GP) search tool suggested index 19, which came in second.
- **Model reliability:** the gap predictions were uneven. They gave about 0.03–0.05 eV for two Sb-rich hypothetical structures and 4.2 eV for ZnSb2O4, so I used them only as a rough guide.
- **Untested gaps:** I measured nothing between Sb 0.22 and 0.65 or above 0.75, so a better composition could be there. I spent none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase assignments are inferred from composition alone.
